def snap(f):
    return [(n['color'],n['pixels'],tuple(n['boundary'][0])) for n in f.segmentation['nodes']]
def trymouse(tag,row,col):
    before=snap(current_frame)
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':row,'col':col}])
    after=snap(current_frame)
    r=last_action_result
    term={k:r[k] for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over') if r.get(k)}
    ch = "CHANGED" if before!=after else "no"
    print(f"{tag} ({row},{col}): {ch} term={term}")
    if before!=after:
        print("  BEFORE:",before); print("  AFTER :",after)
    return before!=after or term
